fields.title: Life in Israel after the events of 7 October 2023
fields.bodyHtml:
Against the background of the recent events of 7 October 2023, when clashes took place on Israel's southern borders and in the Gaza Strip, life in the central regions of the country, Tel Aviv among them, continued at its usual pace.

Events in Gaza did not affect life in Tel Aviv, where the peaceful atmosphere was not disturbed by the tension in the south. City services, including educational institutions and commercial premises, operated as normal, and residents continued to enjoy the benefits of civilised life, including access to medical care of the highest quality.

The airlines connecting Israel with the world, Russia among them, confirmed that their schedules remained stable, maintaining a reliable connection between the countries.

We are following the situation closely in order to provide up-to-date information on the state of affairs in Israel, particularly as regards the provision of medical care. A detailed analysis of the situation and its possible consequences for healthcare and for patient safety is set out in our most recent publication.
